title: Measurement Validity in LLM Cultural Alignment
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLMs using the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map, which explicitly includes survey questions evaluating religious values ('Importance of God') and moral/ethical judgments ('Justifiability of Homosexuality', 'Justifiability of Abortion'). The authors analyze model behaviors, including categorical refusals, on these deeply value-laden moral and religious topics.
